 Nathan Fielder and Theranos' Elizabeth Holmes have intense exchange in 'You Can See Everything' doc trailer 
 1:17 
 'You Can See Everything' trailer: Nathan Fielder has some questions for Elizabeth Holmes 
 Emmy Rossum and Elizabeth Meriwether weigh in on 'Furious's taboo but tender crime tale 
 12:38 
 'Daily Show's Desi Lydic roasts Melania Trump's new documentary with a brutal parody trailer 
 You Can See Everything , Nathan Fielder's documentary about Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes, is going so viral that it was only a matter of time before one of the late shows parodied it.
 In the clip above Jamie Lee Curtis plays Holmes and Jimmy Fallon plays Fielder, sitting opposite each other to recreate that famously intense moment from the teaser .
 "Be honest, do you really want to be on the show tonight?" asks Fallon/Fielder.
 "Of course I do," responds Lee Curtis/Holmes. "I love talking to you."
